title: Introduction to Programming
objectives: Introduce students to fundamental programming concepts using Python. Topics include variables, data types, control flow (conditionals and loops), functions, recursion, file I/O, and basic data structures (lists, tuples, dictionaries). Lab component covers hands-on programming exercises.
syllabus: Unit 1: Introduction to Python - variables, expressions, statements. Unit 2: Control flow - if-else, while, for loops. Unit 3: Functions - definition, arguments, return values, recursion. Unit 4: Data structures - lists, tuples, sets, dictionaries. Unit 5: File handling and exceptions. Unit 6: Introduction to object-oriented programming.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Calculus and Its Applications
objectives: Develop understanding of single and multivariable calculus with engineering and data science applications. Topics include limits, derivatives, integrals, sequences, series, and partial differentiation.
syllabus: Unit 1: Functions, limits and continuity. Unit 2: Differentiation - rules, chain rule, implicit differentiation, L'Hopital's rule. Unit 3: Integration - indefinite and definite integrals, fundamental theorem of calculus, techniques of integration. Unit 4: Sequences and series - convergence, Taylor and Maclaurin series. Unit 5: Multivariable calculus - partial derivatives, gradient, chain rule, maxima and minima.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Physics I
objectives: Introduce classical mechanics, waves, and special theory of relativity. Develop problem-solving skills in physics relevant to engineering applications.
syllabus: Unit 1: Vectors, laws of motion, work and energy. Unit 2: Rotational motion, angular momentum. Unit 3: Oscillations - simple harmonic motion, damped and forced oscillations. Unit 4: Waves - wave equation, superposition, standing waves, Doppler effect. Unit 5: Special theory of relativity - Lorentz transformation, time dilation, mass-energy equivalence.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms
objectives: Understand fundamental data structures and algorithm design and analysis. Topics include arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, graphs, sorting, searching, and algorithm complexity.
syllabus: Unit 1: Algorithm analysis - Big-O notation, recurrences, master theorem. Unit 2: Linear data structures - arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues. Unit 3: Trees - binary trees, BST, AVL trees, B-trees, heaps. Unit 4: Graph algorithms - BFS, DFS, shortest paths (Dijkstra, Bellman-Ford), MST (Kruskal, Prim). Unit 5: Sorting and searching - merge sort, quick sort, heap sort, binary search. Unit 6: Dynamic programming and greedy algorithms.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Linear Algebra
objectives: Develop proficiency in linear algebra concepts essential for data science and machine learning. Topics include vector spaces, linear transformations, matrix decompositions, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.
syllabus: Unit 1: Vectors and matrices - operations, row reduction, echelon form. Unit 2: Vector spaces - subspaces, basis, dimension, rank. Unit 3: Linear transformations - kernel, image, matrix representation. Unit 4: Eigenvalues and eigenvectors - characteristic polynomial, diagonalisation. Unit 5: Inner product spaces - orthogonality, Gram-Schmidt process. Unit 6: Singular value decomposition (SVD) and applications.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Probability and Statistics
objectives: Provide rigorous treatment of probability theory and statistical inference for data science applications. Topics include probability spaces, random variables, common distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing.
syllabus: Unit 1: Probability spaces - sample space, events, axioms, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem. Unit 2: Random variables - discrete and continuous distributions (Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson, Uniform, Exponential, Normal). Unit 3: Joint distributions, marginal and conditional distributions, independence. Unit 4: Expectation, variance, covariance, moment generating functions. Unit 5: Law of large numbers and central limit theorem. Unit 6: Statistical inference - point and interval estimation, hypothesis testing, p-values.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Database Management Systems
objectives: Understand database system design, SQL, relational algebra, normalisation, transaction management and indexing. Students will design, implement and query relational databases.
syllabus: Unit 1: Introduction - data models, database architecture, three-schema architecture. Unit 2: Relational model - relational algebra and calculus, SQL DDL and DML. Unit 3: Database design - ER modelling, normalisation (1NF, 2NF, 3NF, BCNF). Unit 4: Indexing and hashing - B+ trees, hash indexes. Unit 5: Query processing and optimisation. Unit 6: Transaction management - ACID properties, concurrency control, recovery.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Introduction to Machine Learning
objectives: Introduce the foundational concepts, algorithms and applications of machine learning. Students will implement supervised, unsupervised and basic reinforcement learning algorithms and evaluate their performance.
syllabus: Unit 1: ML fundamentals - supervised vs unsupervised learning, bias-variance tradeoff, overfitting. Unit 2: Linear models - linear regression, logistic regression, regularisation (Ridge, LASSO). Unit 3: Classification - k-NN, decision trees, random forests, SVM. Unit 4: Unsupervised learning - k-means clustering, hierarchical clustering, PCA. Unit 5: Model evaluation - cross-validation, ROC curves, confusion matrix, performance metrics. Unit 6: Neural network basics - perceptron, multi-layer networks, backpropagation.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Data Mining and Warehousing
objectives: Understand data preprocessing, data warehouse design, OLAP, association rule mining, classification, clustering, and anomaly detection applied to large datasets.
syllabus: Unit 1: Data preprocessing - cleaning, integration, transformation, reduction. Unit 2: Data warehouse - architecture, OLAP, star and snowflake schemas. Unit 3: Frequent pattern mining - Apriori algorithm, FP-growth, association rules. Unit 4: Classification methods - Naive Bayes, decision trees applied to mining. Unit 5: Clustering - DBSCAN, expectation-maximisation. Unit 6: Anomaly detection and advanced topics.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Deep Learning
objectives: Provide in-depth understanding of deep learning architectures including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, attention mechanisms, and transformers. Students will implement and train deep neural networks for real-world tasks.
syllabus: Unit 1: Review of neural networks, backpropagation, optimisation (SGD, Adam). Unit 2: Convolutional Neural Networks - architecture, pooling, training, transfer learning. Unit 3: Recurrent Neural Networks - vanilla RNN, LSTM, GRU, sequence modelling. Unit 4: Attention mechanisms and Transformers - self-attention, multi-head attention, BERT basics. Unit 5: Generative models - VAEs, GANs. Unit 6: Practical deep learning - regularisation, batch normalisation, hyperparameter tuning.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Natural Language Processing
objectives: Introduce the theory and practice of natural language processing. Topics include text preprocessing, language models, word embeddings, sequence labelling, parsing, sentiment analysis, machine translation, and question answering.
syllabus: Unit 1: Text preprocessing - tokenisation, stemming, lemmatisation, POS tagging, NER. Unit 2: Language models - n-gram models, perplexity, neural language models. Unit 3: Word representations - word2vec, GloVe, contextual embeddings (BERT). Unit 4: Sequence modelling for NLP - CRFs, RNNs for sequence labelling. Unit 5: Syntactic parsing - dependency parsing, constituency parsing. Unit 6: Downstream tasks - sentiment analysis, machine translation, question answering.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Computer Vision
objectives: Cover fundamentals of computer vision including image formation, feature extraction, object detection, image segmentation, and 3D vision. Hands-on implementation using deep learning frameworks.
syllabus: Unit 1: Image formation - cameras, optics, geometric transformations. Unit 2: Image processing - filtering, edge detection (Sobel, Canny), morphology. Unit 3: Feature extraction - SIFT, HOG, deep features. Unit 4: Object detection - sliding windows, R-CNN, YOLO, SSD. Unit 5: Image segmentation - semantic and instance segmentation (Mask R-CNN, U-Net). Unit 6: 3D vision - stereo vision, depth estimation, point clouds.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Operating Systems
objectives: Understand operating system concepts including process management, memory management, file systems, and I/O. Relevant to data pipeline engineering and high-performance computing in data science.
syllabus: Unit 1: Introduction - OS structure, system calls, processes. Unit 2: Process management - scheduling algorithms, synchronisation, deadlock. Unit 3: Memory management - paging, segmentation, virtual memory. Unit 4: File systems - file organisation, directory structure, disk scheduling. Unit 5: I/O systems and storage. Unit 6: Security and protection.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Reinforcement Learning
objectives: Introduce the theory and algorithms of reinforcement learning. Topics include Markov decision processes, dynamic programming, Monte Carlo methods, temporal-difference learning, policy gradient methods, and deep RL.
syllabus: Unit 1: Markov decision processes - states, actions, rewards, policies, value functions. Unit 2: Dynamic programming - policy evaluation, policy improvement, value iteration. Unit 3: Monte Carlo methods - prediction and control. Unit 4: Temporal-difference learning - TD(0), SARSA, Q-learning. Unit 5: Function approximation - linear approximation, neural network Q-learning (DQN). Unit 6: Policy gradient methods - REINFORCE, actor-critic, PPO.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Big Data Analytics
objectives: Learn scalable data processing frameworks and techniques for big data analytics. Topics include Hadoop ecosystem, Apache Spark, stream processing, NoSQL databases, and distributed machine learning.
syllabus: Unit 1: Big data concepts - 3Vs (volume, velocity, variety), Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, MapReduce). Unit 2: Apache Spark - RDDs, DataFrames, Spark SQL, MLlib. Unit 3: Stream processing - Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming, Flink concepts. Unit 4: NoSQL databases - key-value, document, column-family, graph databases. Unit 5: Distributed machine learning - parameter servers, federated learning concepts. Unit 6: Case studies and project.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page. DS302 listed as hard prerequisite; CS302 listed as recommended.

title: Optimisation Methods
objectives: Cover classical and modern optimisation methods used in machine learning and operations research. Topics include convex optimisation, linear programming, gradient-based methods, constrained optimisation.
syllabus: Unit 1: Convexity - convex sets and functions, optimality conditions. Unit 2: Linear programming - simplex method, duality. Unit 3: Unconstrained optimisation - gradient descent, Newton's method, quasi-Newton methods. Unit 4: Constrained optimisation - Lagrangian multipliers, KKT conditions. Unit 5: Stochastic optimisation - SGD, Adam, momentum methods. Unit 6: Applications in machine learning.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Computer Networks
objectives: Understand computer networking fundamentals relevant to distributed data systems and cloud computing. Topics include layered network architecture, TCP/IP, routing, DNS, HTTP, and network security basics.
syllabus: Unit 1: Introduction - network architecture, OSI and TCP/IP models. Unit 2: Application layer - HTTP, DNS, SMTP, P2P. Unit 3: Transport layer - TCP, UDP, flow control, congestion control. Unit 4: Network layer - IP addressing, routing algorithms (OSPF, BGP). Unit 5: Link layer - Ethernet, MAC, ARP. Unit 6: Network security basics.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Ethics and Fairness in AI
objectives: Address ethical dimensions of AI and data science including algorithmic bias, fairness, transparency, accountability, privacy, and societal impact. Students will analyse case studies and develop frameworks for responsible AI.
syllabus: Unit 1: AI ethics landscape - key principles, stakeholders, regulatory context. Unit 2: Algorithmic bias - sources, measurement, mitigation. Unit 3: Fairness - definitions (demographic parity, equalised odds), trade-offs. Unit 4: Explainability and interpretability - LIME, SHAP, model cards. Unit 5: Privacy - differential privacy, federated learning, data governance. Unit 6: Societal impact, policy, and professional responsibility.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page.

title: Capstone Project
objectives: Students undertake a substantial research or applied project integrating skills from across the DSAI programme. Projects may involve real-world data, novel models, or deployment of ML systems. Students work under faculty supervision and present their findings.
syllabus: Unit 1: Project definition and literature review. Unit 2: Data collection and preprocessing. Unit 3: Model design and development. Unit 4: Experimentation, evaluation, and iteration. Unit 5: Technical writing and report preparation. Unit 6: Final presentation and demonstration.
notes: Manually transcribed from IIT Bhilai B.Tech DSAI curriculum page. Prerequisite is credit completion, not a specific course.
